payload.name: bluerails
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: bluerails helps users find hotels in Germany, Austria and Switzerland by place, radius, country and hotel classification. For specified dates and guests, it retrieves available room offers, whole-stay totals, average nightly prices, and cancellation terms and photos where supplied. Users can compare offers against a nightly budget and follow booking links to complete reservations on external booking sites; dates and guest details are included where supported. When rates cannot be retrieved, the app reports prices as unknown and provides a booking link where one is available. Confirmed unavailability is distinguished from failed rate lookups. Hotel and room results are displayed inline in the conversation.
payload.longDescription: bluerails 帮助用户按地点、半径、国家和酒店等级查找德国、奥地利和瑞士的酒店。针对指定日期和入住客人，它会获取可预订的客房报价、整个住宿期间的总价、平均每晚价格，以及提供的取消条款和照片。用户可以根据每晚预算比较报价，并通过预订链接在外部预订网站完成预订；网站支持时会包含日期和客人信息。无法获取房价时，应用会将价格标为未知，并在有链接时提供预订链接。已确认无房与房价查询失败会区分显示。酒店和客房结果直接显示在对话中。

payload.name: Goldsainte Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Goldsainte’s live hotel inventory directly in ChatGPT. Travelers can search by destination and dates, compare live rates and availability, view property details and room options, refresh current pricing, and open the full hotel experience on Goldsainte. Users can also securely connect their Goldsainte account for account-aware features.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索 Goldsainte 的实时酒店库存。旅行者可以按目的地和日期搜索、比较实时价格和空房情况、查看酒店详情和房型、刷新当前价格，并在 Goldsainte 上打开完整酒店预订体验。用户还可以安全连接 Goldsainte 账户，以使用与账户相关的功能。

payload.name: Greenfee365 Platform
payload.description: 实时高尔夫开球时间与果岭费
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan a single round or a whole golf trip. Greenfee365 searches live tee times and green fee prices at more than 1,400 bookable golf courses, from the Costa del Sol and the Algarve to Scotland, Thailand and the UAE. Ask for a course, a city or a destination and get the times that are genuinely available, the price per player in local currency and how many spots are left. Prices come straight from the Greenfee365 booking platform, so what you see is what the course is selling right now, not an estimate. When you have found your time you get a link to greenfee365.com with date and party size already filled in, and you complete the booking there. No account needed to search.
payload.longDescription: 规划一场高尔夫或完整的高尔夫之旅。Greenfee365 可搜索 1,400 多家可预订球场的实时开球时间和果岭费，地点从太阳海岸和阿尔加维到苏格兰、泰国和阿联酋。你可以询问球场、城市或目的地，并获取确实可用的时段、当地货币的每位球员价格以及剩余名额。价格直接来自 Greenfee365 预订平台，因此显示的是球场当前实际报价，而非估算。选好时间后，你会收到 greenfee365.com 链接，日期和人数已预先填好，并可在那里完成预订。搜索无需账号。

payload.name: Southwest Airlines
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore Southwest Airlines destinations, schedules, flights, and fares. View flight options and continue to Southwest.com to complete the booking.
payload.longDescription: 探索 Southwest Airlines 的目的地、时刻表、航班和票价。查看航班选项，然后前往 Southwest.com 完成预订。

payload.name: Gloria Palace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Gloria Palace Assistant helps guests explore the chain, find hotel information, and manage reservations through chat.
Users can discover the properties in the chain and ask about rooms, amenities, services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can check availability, compare room and board options, and list optional extras.
Guests can create a reservation after explicitly confirming their selection and providing the required guest details. Existing reservations can be retrieved using the required booking credentials, and date changes or cancellations require explicit confirmation.
Example questions:
“Which Gloria Palace properties can I choose from?”
“What room types does Gloria Palace San Agustín offer?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me my booking details.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
payload.longDescription:
Gloria Palace Assistant 可帮助住客了解酒店集团、查找酒店信息并通过聊天管理预订。
用户可以查看集团旗下酒店，并询问客房、设施、服务、政策以及入住/退房时间。助手可以查询空房情况、比较房型和膳食方案，并列出可选的额外服务。
住客可以在明确确认所选方案并提供所需住客信息后创建预订。使用必要的预订凭证可查询现有预订；更改日期或取消预订均需明确确认。
示例问题：
“我可以选择哪些 Gloria Palace 酒店？”
“Gloria Palace San Agustín 提供哪些房型？”
“下周末有空房吗？”
“显示我的预订详情。”
“修改预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”

payload.name: Booking Wolf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Booking Wolf helps travellers find and book hotels, tours and activities. Tell ChatGPT where you're going, your dates and how many people, and you get real options with prices, photos, ratings and what's included.

For a hotel you see the rate for your dates, and alongside it the prices publicly listed for the same room on other travel sites, so you can see what the room costs before deciding. First-time guests also see the credit their booking earns towards a future stay.

For tours and activities you see the price, what the day involves, and whether the tour actually runs on the date you asked about.

When you pick something, the booking link takes you to bookingwolf.com to finish on our secure checkout.
payload.longDescription:
Booking Wolf 帮助旅行者查找和预订酒店、旅行团和活动。告诉 ChatGPT 目的地、日期和人数，即可获取附有价格、照片、评分和所含内容的真实选项。

对于酒店，你会看到所选日期的房价，以及其他旅行网站上同一客房的公开价格，方便在决定前了解房价。首次入住的客人还能看到这次预订可赚取多少用于未来住宿的抵用额度。

对于旅行团和活动，你会看到价格、当天的安排，以及该旅行团是否真的在你询问的日期出团。

选定后，预订链接会带你前往 bookingwolf.com，在我们的安全结账页面完成预订。

payload.name: Standby: Theme Park Companion
payload.description: 主题乐园等候时间、开放时间和信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spend less time searching and more time enjoying your park day. Standby brings attraction wait times, ride status, showtimes, and park hours into your ChatGPT conversation.

Explore supported Disney, Universal, and other theme parks, compare waits, and decide what to do next—whether you’re planning your visit or already inside the park!
payload.longDescription:
少花时间搜索，多享受乐园之旅。Standby 会将游乐设施等候时间、运行状态、演出时间和乐园开放时间带入你的 ChatGPT 对话。

探索受支持的 Disney、Universal 等主题乐园，比较等候时间并决定接下来做什么——无论你是在规划行程，还是已经身处乐园！

payload.name: Slothy by CRMaps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Slothy is your local companion for discovering Costa Rica. It helps users explore destinations, places to visit, restaurants, activities, businesses, and practical information using content published and verified by CRMaps. It provides concise recommendations, direct links, and images when available. When information is not confirmed, it says so clearly. It is read-only: it does not make reservations, process payments, or modify information.
payload.longDescription: Slothy 是你探索哥斯达黎加的本地伙伴。它利用由 CRMaps 发布并核实的内容，帮助用户了解目的地、景点、餐厅、活动、商家和实用信息。信息可用时，它会提供简明推荐、直接链接和图片。若信息未经确认，它会明确说明。此工具为只读，不会预订、处理付款或修改信息。

payload.name: Flightcat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flightcat searches airfare for one-way, round-trip, and multi-city trips, resolves broad and fuzzy locations and flexible dates, and displays up to 10 flight options with prices, schedules, stops, and booking links.
payload.longDescription: Flightcat 可搜索单程、往返和多城市行程的机票，识别宽泛或模糊的地点及灵活日期，并最多展示 10 个航班选项，包括价格、时刻表、中转信息和预订链接。

payload.name: Easybook
payload.description: 预订巴士、渡轮及火车行程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search live bus, ferry, and train schedules and fares with Easybook. Compare available trips across Malaysia, Singapore, and Southeast Asia to find convenient travel options for your journey.
payload.longDescription: 通过Easybook搜索实时的巴士、渡轮和火车时刻表及票价。在马来西亚、新加坡和东南亚地区比较可用的行程，找到适合您旅程的便捷出行选项。

payload.name: VIPCars.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and compare live car rental prices at airports with VIPCars.com. Review available rental cars by vehicle type, supplier, price, rental policies, inclusions, mileage, deposit, and customer rating. Select a deal and continue to VIPCars.com to complete your booking. You can also retrieve an existing reservation using the booking reference and matching email address, then access options to manage it.
payload.longDescription: 通过VIPCars.com在机场搜索并比较实时租车价格。通过车型、供应商、价格、租赁政策、包含项目、里程数、押金及客户评分来查看可用的租车选项。选择优惠套餐，然后继续前往VIPCars.com完成预订。您也可以通过预订参考号及匹配的电子邮件地址检索现有预订，然后访问管理选项。

payload.name: Solartrip
payload.description: 为您行程定制的住宿体验
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover your next stay directly in ChatGPT, and let Solartrip take care of the details so you can enjoy the journey.

- Explore a wide selection of stays, from serene villas and spa hotels to lively city apartments, based on your destination, travel dates, and preferences.
- Found the right stay? Continue to Solartrip.com to check the latest price and booking conditions, then complete your reservation.
- Pay your way on Solartrip.com with a credit or debit card or with cryptocurrency.
- Make every stay more rewarding with Solar Cash, earned after your stay and ready to use on future hotel bookings.
- Travel with peace of mind and connect with Solartrip’s 24/7 support team whenever you need help.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接发现您的下一次住宿选择，让Solartrip处理细节，让您专注享受旅程。

- 根据您的目的地、出行日期和偏好，探索从宁静别墅、水疗酒店到活力城市公寓的多样住宿选择。
- 找到合适的住宿？
前往Solartrip.com查看最新价格和预订条件，完成预订。
- 通过Solartrip.com使用信用卡/借记卡或加密货币支付。
- 通过Solar Cash让每次住宿更值得，入住后获得的Solar Cash可用于未来酒店预订。
- 24/7全天候支持团队随时为您服务，出行更安心。

payload.name: MOT Check
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Check any UK-registered car, van or motorcycle's MOT using official DVSA test records. Give it a registration and you get whether the vehicle has a valid MOT and when it expires, when a newer vehicle's first MOT is due, and the result, mileage, advisories and defects from its latest test — plus the full MOT history going back through every recorded test.

The history check flags whether recorded mileage ever went down between tests, a common sign of clocking or a recording error, which is worth knowing before buying a used car. Advisories and failures come back in plain language rather than DVSA shorthand.

Data comes from the DVSA MOT History API, the official UK government record of MOT tests, with tax and MOT status from the DVLA. Every answer links to the vehicle's full record on motcheck.io.

No account or sign-in is needed. MOT records contain no personal information about a vehicle's keeper. UK-registered vehicles only (Great Britain and Northern Ireland).
payload.longDescription:
通过官方DVSA测试记录，可检查任何英国注册的汽车、货车或摩托车的MOT信息。输入车牌号即可获取车辆是否拥有有效MOT、有效期至何时、新车首次MOT何时到期，以及最近一次检测的结果、里程数、建议事项和缺陷记录——还包括追溯至每次记录的完整MOT历史。

历史记录会标记两次检测间里程数是否出现下降，这通常是调表或记录错误的迹象，了解这一点对购买二手车非常重要。建议事项和故障信息会以通俗易懂的语言呈现，而非DVSA的缩写术语。

数据来源于DVSA MOT历史API，即英国政府官方的MOT检测记录，包含来自DVLA的税费和MOT状态信息。每个查询结果都会链接至motcheck.io上的车辆完整记录。

无需账户或登录即可使用。MOT记录不包含车辆所有人的个人信息。仅支持英国注册车辆（大不列颠及北爱尔兰地区）。

payload.name: Voyscout.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Voyscout publishes historical flight and package price observations for 47 destinations. Its five read-only tools let users browse destinations and measured spans, retrieve a destination's history (with resort aliases identified), compare latest measurements with their own histories, rank observed rails against their historical data, and compare 2–8 destinations side by side in the order requested.

These are observations, not live quotes or buy recommendations. Voyscout does not book trips or provide booking links. Prices use CZK, and the published dataset is reusable under CC BY 4.0 with attribution. Measured spans, price coverage and freshness details are given where each tool provides them; flight origins are reported as clusters that may not cover every published price. No account, authentication or API key is required.
payload.longDescription:
Voyscout为47个目的地提供历史航班及包裹价格数据。其五个只读工具允许用户浏览目的地和测量时间段，获取特定目的地的历史数据（包含识别的度假村别名），将最新测量数据与自身历史数据对比，根据历史数据对观测到的票价进行排序，以及按用户指定顺序并排对比2-8个目的地。

以上数据为历史观测记录，非实时报价或购买建议。Voyscout不提供行程预订或预订链接。价格单位为捷克克朗（CZK），发布数据集可依据CC BY 4.0协议进行再使用并需注明来源。各工具会提供对应的测量时间段、价格覆盖范围及更新信息，航班出发地以聚类形式展示，可能无法覆盖所有发布价格。使用无需账户、认证或API密钥。

payload.name: BEACON by Owner Connect
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BEACON lets you talk to a specific private aircraft. Each aircraft's owner decides what BEACON may say about it, and nothing else is shared.

Ask about a tail number to see what public record says about it (the FAA registration, the airframe and engines, registry history) and the facts its owner approved, such as type, year and passenger seats.

Planning a trip? Ask what a route would cost, for example Teterboro to Miami. BEACON works out the flight time from the owner's own numbers and gives an approximate total, including positioning from where the aircraft is parked when the owner charges for it. It is never a quote: the booking contact confirms the price.

Ready to go ahead? BEACON can send your trip request, or a buyer's inquiry, straight to the person the owner named. You confirm by email first, and nothing is sent until you do.

BEACON never books a flight, holds an aircraft or takes payment. Any flight is arranged and operated by a certificated operator. No asking price is ever published.
payload.longDescription:
BEACON让你与特定的私人飞机进行对话。
每架飞机的机主决定BEACON可以透露哪些信息，其他内容均不会共享。

查询飞机尾号即可查看公开记录中的信息（包括FAA注册信息、机身和发动机详情、登记历史），以及机主核准的资料，例如机型、年份和乘客座位数。

计划行程时？
可以询问航线费用，例如从特特博罗到迈阿密。
BEACON会根据机主提供的数据计算飞行时间，并给出包含飞机调机费用的预估总费用（调机费用根据飞机停放位置计算）。
这始终不是正式报价：需经预订联系人确认价格后方可生效。

准备继续？
BEACON可将你的行程请求，或买家咨询，直接发送给机主指定的联系人。
需先通过邮件确认，待确认后信息才会发送。

BEACON从不预订航班、保留飞机或收取费用。
任何航班均由持牌运营商安排和运营。
绝不会公布任何报价。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up a private aircraft by tail number, Estimate an approximate charter cost for a route, Send a trip request to the owner's booking contact, Send a buyer's inquiry to the owner's representative

payload.name: Trains on Map
payload.description: 实时火车地图与延误信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live answers about passenger trains in 12 countries: where a train is now, how late it is, which stops it has left, what is leaving a station and from which platform, service alerts, and how punctual a train has been. Every answer carries a link to the same train or station on the live map. Read-only and account-free: it cannot book, cancel or pay for a ticket. Data handling: https://trainsonmap.com/privacy
payload.longDescription:
提供12个国家乘客火车的实时信息：当前火车位置、晚点情况、已经过的站点、车站有哪些列车发车及对应的站台、服务警报，以及火车的准点记录。
每个信息条目都包含通往实时地图上对应火车或车站的链接。
只读且无需账户：无法订票、取消或支付车票。
数据处理政策：https://trainsonmap.com/privacy

payload.name: DroneClear Thailand
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Planning to fly a drone in Thailand? Enter your drone (model or weight), whether it has a camera, where you will fly and why. DroneClear Thailand tells you what you need — CAAT and NBTC registration, the 1,000,000 THB third-party insurance and the main flight rules — each with its source, and which registration or insurance service fits, with a link to droneclearthailand.com. Info only, not legal advice; no personal data is collected in ChatGPT. Antworten auch auf Deutsch.
payload.longDescription:
计划在泰国驾驶无人机吗？
输入您的无人机（型号或重量）、是否带有摄像头、您将在何处飞行以及原因。
DroneClear Thailand会告知您所需信息——CAAT和NBTC注册、1,000,000泰铢第三者责任保险以及主要飞行规则——每项都有来源，并推荐适合的注册或保险服务，并附上droneclearthailand.com的链接。
信息仅供参考，不是法律建议；ChatGPT不会收集任何个人数据。
Antworten auch auf Deutsch.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check Thailand drone rules for a drone, place and purpose, Explain CAAT and NBTC registration and the insurance requirement, with sources, Answer in English or German

payload.name: Stymie Golf
payload.description: 寻找高尔夫球场。规划您的比赛。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find golf courses near a town, transit station, address or US ZIP, then build a shortlist for your next golf trip. Filter by public or private access, hole count and published tee yardage or slope. Explore course details, scorecards, architects, golf equipment and recently checked deals with links to Stymie.

Stymie reads public directory data without an account. Course cards help you compare picks and open the original pages. Coverage varies by country and course. Distances are straight-line estimates; confirm access, seasonal opening and availability directly with each course. Stymie does not book tee times, process payments, enroll you in alerts or access private account data. Equipment offer links may earn Stymie a commission at no extra cost to you.
payload.longDescription:
在城镇、交通枢纽、地址或美国邮政编码附近查找高尔夫球场，然后为您的下一次高尔夫旅行建立短名单。
按公共或私人访问权限、洞数以及已发布的发球台码距或坡度进行筛选。
探索球场详情、记分卡、建筑师、高尔夫装备以及与Stymie链接的最近检查优惠。

Stymie无需账户即可读取公共目录数据。
球场卡片帮助您比较选择并打开原始页面。
覆盖范围因国家和球场而异。
距离为直线估算；请直接与每个球场确认访问权限、季节性开放时间和可用性。
Stymie不预订发球时间、处理支付、为您注册警报或访问私人账户数据。
设备优惠链接可能在不增加您任何费用的情况下为Stymie带来佣金。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find nearby golf courses, Build golf trip shortlists, Read course details and scorecards, Explore architects and course rankings, Compare equipment and recently checked deals

payload.name: Cria.al
payload.description: 在阿尔巴尼亚寻找租车服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find and compare rental cars for a trip to Albania with Cria.al, a marketplace of local rental companies. Tell ChatGPT where and when you need a car, and it searches live availability at Tirana International Airport, Kukës International Airport and cities across the country, including Tirana, Durrës, Vlorë, Sarandë, Shkodër, Berat, Gjirokastër and Korçë.

Compare whole-trip prices for your exact dates, with the extras you ask for included: full or partial insurance, a child seat, unlimited kilometres, or permission to drive into Montenegro, Kosovo, North Macedonia, Greece, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Serbia. Narrow the search by automatic or manual gearbox, car type (from small city cars to SUVs, 4x4s and vans), fuel, number of seats, budget, or cars without a security deposit, and plan one-way rentals between two locations.

For any car, see its specs, photos, deposit, pickup and return locations with delivery fees, the rental company's opening hours and rating, the minimum rental days, the minimum driver age, how long cancellation stays free, the payment methods accepted at pickup and the price of each extra. When you have chosen, you get a link to book that car on cria.al with your trip filled in.

Search works without signing in. The tools read public listings and do not reserve cars, take payments, manage existing reservations or access account information. Availability and the final price are confirmed at checkout on cria.al, and the rental company then accepts or declines the request.
payload.longDescription:
通过Cria.al预订阿尔巴尼亚租车，这是一个本地租车公司的市场。向ChatGPT说明您需要用车的时间和地点，它将实时搜索地拉那国际机场、库克斯国际机场以及全国各城市的租车信息，包括地拉那、都拉斯、发罗拉、萨兰达、斯库台、伯尔特、吉诺卡斯特和科赤的可用情况。

payload.name: Poker: play, practice, improve
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Because ChatGPT is part of the experience, every session can be different. You can ask simple questions or difficult ones. You can ask for short answers or longer lessons. You can even ask the AI to explain things as if you are five years old. The game grows with your skill level.

Use this app to practice without the pressure of a real poker table. Try ideas you have never tested before. Make mistakes. Learn from them. Build confidence hand after hand. Poker is a game of skill, patience, and good decisions, and practice helps every player improve.

Whether you want a quick game during a break or a longer session to study strategy, this app is ready. Play a few hands. Play a full game. Stop to ask questions whenever you like. Every conversation helps you understand the game a little better.

If you enjoy games that make you think, if you want to improve at Texas Hold’em, or if you simply want to play poker with an AI that can explain its thinking, this app is made for you. Deal the cards. Make your move. Ask your questions. Learn something new. Then play the next hand with a little more confidence than before.
payload.longDescription:
与 AI 对手玩德州扑克，然后和 ChatGPT 讨论每一手牌。这不仅是一款扑克游戏，也是一个对弈、学习、提问并逐手提升的地方。如果您是扑克新手，AI 可以帮助您了解局势；如果您已经熟悉游戏，可以测试想法、尝试新策略并复盘自己的选择。每场游戏都是学习的机会。

学习扑克不必很难。复杂概念会用简短易懂的语言解释。如果您不知道什么是翻牌、转牌、河牌或盲注，只管提问。想了解底池赔率，也可以问。如果需要解读公共牌，或在跟注、加注和弃牌之间作选择，都可以提问。AI 会清晰友好地解释每一步。

您可以自由选择玩法。尝试稳健打法或大胆打法，多诈唬或少诈唬，看看结果如何。如果进展顺利，问问原因；如果出了差错，问问下次可以怎么做。每个选择都可能带来新的收获。

这款应用也适合有经验的玩家探索策略、比较想法并分析棘手局面。讨论手牌范围、位置、价值下注、听牌和抓诈唬。询问还可以采用哪些其他打法，或者其他玩家可能如何行动。对话可以深入到您希望的程度。

ChatGPT 是体验的一部分，因此每次游戏都可以不同。您可以提出简单或复杂的问题，也可以要求简短回答或详细讲解，甚至可以让 AI 像给五岁孩子解释一样说明。游戏会随着您的技能水平变化。

使用此应用，无须承受真实牌桌的压力即可练习。尝试从未测试过的想法，犯错并从中学习，逐手建立信心。扑克讲究技巧、耐心和明智决策；练习能帮助每位玩家进步。

无论您是想在休息时快速玩几手，还是用更长时间研究策略，此应用都已准备就绪。玩几手，打一场完整牌局，或随时停下来提问。每次对话都会让您更了解这款游戏。

如果您喜欢需要动脑的游戏，想提高德州扑克水平，或只是想和能解释思路的 AI 一起打扑克，这款应用正适合您。发牌、行动、提问、学习新知识，然后带着更多信心开始下一手。

payload.longDescription:
借助 AI 搜索和评价分析，发现你下一款最喜欢的 Steam 游戏。

用自然语言搜索 120,000 多款 Steam 游戏——只需描述你想找的类型（例如“轻松的农场经营游戏”或“配乐出色、挑战性强的 roguelike 游戏”），即可浏览带有预告片、截图和价格的结果。

即时获取 Steam 评价的 AI 摘要，将数千名玩家的看法提炼为清晰洞察，了解哪些方面表现出色、哪些方面不尽如人意。可按情感倾向、游戏时长和语言筛选。

深入分析 4.3M 条 roguelite 游戏评价，了解玩家情绪如何随游戏时长变化、比较热门作品，并搜索玩家对“难度”“多人游戏”或“重复可玩性”等具体主题的真实看法。

所有数据均直接来自 Steam，不进行网络搜索，只呈现真实玩家反馈。

payload.name: Movie Pick
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MoviePick helps you discover movies you'll love. Get personalized recommendations based on your taste, track watched films with ratings, manage your wishlist, and instantly identify movies from Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube links — all within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: MoviePick 帮助你发现自己会喜欢的电影。根据你的品味获取个性化推荐、为看过的影片评分并追踪记录、管理愿望清单，还可以直接识别 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 链接中的电影——全部在 ChatGPT 中完成。

payload.name: Snake Retro: Neon Arcade
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Steer the snake, chain quick eats for combo streaks, and climb levels as the pace ramps up—complete with particles, toasts, and screen shake for big moments. Pick difficulty and board size to match your mood, then chase your best score on a ranked leaderboard. Earn points from play to unlock colorful snake skins and collect sixteen badges across food, score, combo, and milestone goals. app is suitable for all ages
payload.longDescription: 操控小蛇，快速连续吃食物以连成组合 streak，并随着节奏加快不断闯关；游戏还包含粒子效果、提示弹窗和关键时刻的屏幕震动。选择适合心情的难度和棋盘大小，然后在排名排行榜上冲击个人最佳成绩。通过游戏赚取积分，解锁色彩丰富的蛇皮肤，并完成围绕食物、得分、连击和里程碑目标设置的十六枚徽章。此应用适合所有年龄段。

payload.name: Eventbrite
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find events by location and see what is happening in the area, with useful details like date, venue, price, and event links all in one place.
payload.longDescription: 按地点查找活动，了解附近正在举办的活动，并在一处查看日期、场地、价格和活动链接等实用信息。

payload.name: Eventfrog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover more than 25'000 events with Eventfrog and find what’s happening near you. Search by location, date, or category, browse event details, and quickly explore concerts, theatre, festivals, nightlife, family activities, and more.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Eventfrog 发现超过 25,000 场活动，了解附近正在发生的事情。按地点、日期或类别搜索，浏览活动详情，轻松查找音乐会、戏剧、节庆、夜生活、家庭活动等。

payload.name: Tubi
payload.description: 免费观看节目、电影和问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask for a hidden gem, a 90s comedy, or whatever suits your mood - Tubi has recs for FREE shows and movies ready to go. And for added fun? Try our trivia game.
payload.longDescription: 告诉 Tubi 你想看一部冷门佳作、90 年代喜剧，或任何符合心情的内容，它就会推荐可免费观看的节目和电影。想增加乐趣？还可以试试问答游戏。

payload.name: StubHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse events and find tickets
payload.longDescription: 浏览活动并查找门票

payload.name: Pitch 1024
payload.description: 真实人声演绎的参考音高
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Pitch 1024 hands you a reference pitch sung by a real musician — not a synthesized beep. Ask for a note, a voiced chord, starting pitches for any key, or a full chord progression, and tap the card to hear it, in the voice of the musician you choose from a cast of six.

Build a chord with several voices harmonizing together — in stereo, or in full 3D around you on headphones — pass a progression around the ensemble one singer per chord, or drill your ear with hidden-answer note, interval, and chord-quality quizzes.

Useful for singers warming up, a cappella groups finding their starting pitches, instrumentalists tuning by ear, and anyone who'd rather match a real voice than a tone generator.
payload.longDescription:
Pitch 1024 为您提供由真实音乐人演唱的参考音高，而非合成提示音。您可以请求单个音符、带人声的和弦、任意调的起始音或完整和弦进行，然后点击卡片聆听，由您从六位歌手中选择的音乐人演唱。

您可以构建多个声部和谐演唱的和弦——以立体声呈现，或通过耳机在完整 3D 空间中呈现；也可以让合唱团中的每位歌手依次演唱和弦进行中的一个和弦，或通过答案隐藏的音符、音程和和弦性质测验训练听力。

适合热身的歌手、寻找起始音的无伴奏合唱团、凭听觉调音的乐器演奏者，以及任何更愿意跟着真人声音而非音调发生器演唱的人。

payload.name: Enzo Reader for RSS Feeds
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enzo Reader helps you keep up with your RSS feeds and news articles. You can catch up on your latest stories, filter by unread items, favorites, feeds, tags, or date ranges, search by what an article really says, open the full text when you want more detail, and quickly mark things read, unread, or saved. It turns a messy reading backlog into something organized, searchable, and easy to stay on top of.
payload.longDescription: Enzo Reader 帮助你及时了解 RSS 订阅源和新闻文章。你可以快速浏览最新内容，按未读、收藏、订阅源、标签或日期范围筛选，按文章实际内容搜索，需要更多信息时打开全文，并快速将内容标记为已读、未读或已保存。它能把杂乱的待读列表整理得有序、可搜索且易于跟进。

payload.name: Fandango
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use this Fandango app directly within ChatGPT to discover movies, browse showtimes, and plan your next movie night - all in one conversation.

Find what to watch with recommendations, explore new and upcoming releases, and search by movie, theater, or location.  See real-time showtimes, making it easy to decide and act in the moment. Plus, check out Rotten Tomatoes scores instantly!

Fandango brings together content, recommendations, and ticketing to power a complete moviegoing experience from conversation to checkout. 

At Fandango, We Love Fans.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 Fandango 应用发现电影、浏览放映时间并规划下一次观影之夜——在一段对话中轻松完成。

通过推荐寻找值得观看的电影，了解新上映和即将上映的作品，并按电影、影院或地点搜索。查看实时放映场次，方便你当下决定并采取行动。此外，还能即时查看 Rotten Tomatoes 评分！

Fandango 汇集内容、推荐和票务服务，打造从对话到结账的完整观影体验。

Fandango 热爱影迷。

payload.name: Achriom
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Keep track of everything you watch, read, and listen to, with a librarian who actually knows your taste. Just tell ChatGPT what you finished, what you thought, and what you're in the mood for next.
payload.longDescription: 通过真正了解你品味的图书管理员，记录你观看、阅读和收听的所有内容。只需告诉 ChatGPT 你看完、读完或听完了什么，有何感想，以及接下来想体验什么。

payload.name: Lots of Lotteries
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看彩票开奖结果
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A quick easy way to see the latest lottery results

e.g.

- "@Lots of Lotteries Show me the latest Powerball numbers"
- "What are the MegaMillions results @Lots of Lotteries ?"
- "@Lots of Lotteries What are the EuroMillions numbers?"

Supported lotteries:

- Powerball (US)
- Mega Millions (US)
- EuroMillions (EU)
- Euro Jackpot (EU)
- Lotto 6/49 (Canada)
- Lotto Max (Canada)
- Lotto (UK)
- Thunderball (UK)
- Oz Lotto (Australia)

- Superenalotto (Italy)
payload.longDescription:
轻松快捷地查看最新彩票结果

例如：

- “@Lots of Lotteries 给我看看最新的 Powerball 号码”
- “@Lots of Lotteries，MegaMillions 的结果是什么？”
- “@Lots of Lotteries，EuroMillions 号码是多少？”

支持的彩票：

- Powerball（美国）
- Mega Millions（美国）
- EuroMillions（欧盟）
- Euro Jackpot（欧盟）
- Lotto 6/49（加拿大）
- Lotto Max（加拿大）
- Lotto（英国）
- Thunderball（英国）
- Oz Lotto（澳大利亚）
- La Primitiva（西班牙）

payload.name: SeatGeek
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Not sure what to see next? Ask about upcoming events and SeatGeek will surface what's happening nearby. Browse listings on interactive venue maps, filter by Deal Score or best seats, then jump to SeatGeek when you're ready to buy.
payload.longDescription: 还不确定接下来要看什么？询问即将举行的活动，SeatGeek 就会展示附近正在发生的活动。通过互动场馆地图浏览列表，按 Deal Score 或最佳座位筛选，准备购买时再跳转到 SeatGeek。

payload.name: CardChain AI
payload.description: 体育和宝可梦卡牌 AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Real trading card market data directly in ChatGPT. Identify any card by photo or search, get live pricing with 30-day history, population reports across graders, and ROI analysis before you grade. See your whole collection's value at a glance, check how a player's season is shaping card demand, and browse cards for sale on the CardChain AI marketplace — all without leaving chat. Built for collectors who care about making the right call before they buy, sell, or grade.
payload.longDescription: 将真实交易卡牌市场数据直接带入 ChatGPT。通过照片或搜索识别任意卡牌，获取含 30 天历史的实时价格、各评级机构的人口报告，以及评级前的投资回报分析。随时查看整个收藏的价值，了解球员赛季如何影响卡牌需求，并在 CardChain AI 市场浏览待售卡牌——无需离开聊天。专为在购买、出售或评级前希望做出正确决定的收藏者打造。

payload.name: Sportily
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sportily helps users discover horse-racing cards, SmartPicks, Value Finder candidates, Race Lens matches, runner profiles, race context, post-race results, and their personal My Picks tracking data through ChatGPT. The app supports access-gated workflows for finding races and horses, analysing race cards, comparing runners, backtesting saved filters, and saving or reviewing private tracked picks.
payload.longDescription: Sportily 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 探索赛马赛事卡、SmartPicks、Value Finder 候选对象、Race Lens 匹配结果、参赛马档案、赛事背景、赛后结果以及个人 My Picks 追踪数据。应用支持受访问权限控制的工作流，用于查找赛事和赛马、分析赛事卡、比较参赛马、对已保存筛选条件进行回测，以及保存或查看私人追踪的选择。
